chapterInfo.content:
16
Nyankopɔn abufuo nkuruwa nson no
1 # Adi 15.7 Na metee nne kɛseɛ bi a ɛfiri asɔredan no mu reka kyerɛ abɔfoɔ baason no sɛ: Monkɔ nkɔhwie Nyankopɔn abufuo nkuruwa nson no ngu asase so. 2#Eks 9.10-11 Na deɛ ɔdi kan no kɔe, na ɔkɔhwiee ne kuruwa no guu asase so. Na nkudaa bɔne a ɛtutuo baa nnipa a wɔwɔ aboa no agyirahyɛdeɛ ne wɔn a wɔkotoo ne honi no so.
3 # Eks 7.17-21 Na deɛ ɔtɔ so mmienu no hwiee ne kuruwa no guu po mu. Na ɛdanee sɛ owufoɔ mogya, na ɛpo no mu mmoa nyinaa wuwuiɛ.
4 # Eks 7.19-24 Na deɛ ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa no hwiee ne kuruwa no guu nsubɔntene ne asutire mu, na ɛdanee mogya. 5Na metee sɛ nsuo so bɔfoɔ no se:
Wo a wowɔ hɔ, na wowɔ hɔ dada, na woyɛ kronkron, wotene,
ɛfiri sɛ woabu atɛn saa,
6na wɔahwie ahotefoɔ ne adiyifoɔ mogya agu,
na woama wɔn mogya anom,
wɔfata saa.
7 # Adi 9.13; 19.2 Na metee sɛ ɛnne bi firi afɔrebukyia no mu a ɛse:
Aane, Awurade Nyankopɔn, adeɛ nyinaa so tumfoɔ,
w’atemmuo yɛ nokorɛ ne tenenee.
8Na deɛ ɔtɔ so nnan no hwiee ne kuruwa no guu owia so. Na wɔmaa no ogya ahoɔden sɛ ɔmfa nhyehye nnipa. 9#Adi 16.11; 16.21; 9.20-21 Na wɔde ahuhuro kɛseɛ hyehyee nnipa, na wɔkaa Onyankopɔn a ɔwɔ ɔhaw mmusuo yi so ahoɔden no din ho abususɛm, na wɔansakyera wɔn adwene anhyɛ no animuonyam.
10 # Eks 10.21; Yes 8.21-22 Na deɛ ɔtɔ so nnum no hwiee ne kuruwa no guu aboa no ahennwa so. Na n’ahennie danee sum, na yea no nti wɔkekaa wɔn tɛkyerɛma, 11#Adi 16.9 na wɔn yea ne wɔn nkudaa nti wɔkaa ɔsoro Nyankopɔn ho abususɛm, na wɔannu wɔn ho wɔ wɔn nnwuma mu.
12 # Yes 11.15-16 Na deɛ ɔtɔ so nsia no hwiee ne kuruwa no guu asubɔnten kɛseɛ Eufrate mu, na emu nsuo wee, na wɔasiesie kwan ama ahemfo a wɔfiri owia apueeɛ nohoa. 13#Eks 8.3; 1 Ah 22.21-23; Adi 12.9; 13.1; 13.11 Na mehunuu ahonhom fi mmiɛnsa a wɔte sɛ mponkyerɛne, sɛ wɔfiri ɔtweaseɛ no anomu ne aboa no anomu ne adiyifoɔ atorofoɔ no anomu. 14#Adi 13.13; 19.19 Na wɔyɛ ahonhommɔne ahonhom a wɔyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ, na wɔfiri kɔ wiase nyinaa ahemfo nkyɛn kɔboaboa wɔn ano ma Onyankopɔn, ade nyinaa so tumfoɔ no, da kɛseɛ no mu ko no. 15#1 Te 5.2; Adi 3.18 (Hwɛ, mereba sɛ owifoɔ. Nhyira ne deɛ ɔwɛn na ɔhwɛ ne ntadeɛ soɔ, na wannante adagya mu, na wɔanhunu ne kwaterekwa.) 16#Ate 5.19; 5.31; 2 Ah 9.27; 23.29; Sak 12.11 Na ɔboaboaa wɔn ano kɔɔ baabi a wɔfrɛ hɔ Hebri kasa mu sɛ Armagedon.
17Na deɛ ɔtɔ so nson no hwiee ne kuruwa no guu ahunum. Na ɛnne kɛseɛ bi firi asɔredan no mu, firi ahennwa no mu, sɛ: Wɔawie. 18#Adi 4.5; 8.5; 11.19 Na anyinam ne ɛnne ne aprannaa bae, na asasewosoɔ kɛseɛ a ɛfiri berɛ a nnipa baa asase soɔ no wɔnhunuu so asasewosoɔ kɛseɛ saa pɛn baeɛ. 19#Adi 11.8; 14.10 Na kuro kɛseɛ no mu paee afaafa mmiɛnsa, na amanaman nkuro hwehwee ase, na wɔkaee Babel kɛseɛ no, Nyankopɔn anim, sɛ wɔbɛma no n’abufuo a emu yɛ den no nsa kuruwa. 20#Adi 6.14; 20.11 Na nsupɔ nyinaa dwanedwanee, na wɔanhunu mmepɔ biara bio. 21#Eks 9.23; Adi 16.9 Na asukɔtweaa akɛseɛ a ɛte sɛ dwetikɛseboɔ firi soro guguu nnipa so, na asukɔtweaa no haw nti nnipa kaa Nyankopɔn ho abususɛm ɛfiri sɛ na ɔhaw no so kɛse.

Na metee nne kɛseɛ bi a ɛfiri asɔredan no mu reka kyerɛ abɔfoɔ baason no sɛ: Monkɔ nkɔhwie Nyankopɔn abufuo nkuruwa nson no ngu asase so. Na deɛ ɔdi kan no kɔe, na ɔkɔhwiee ne kuruwa no guu asase so. Na nkudaa bɔne a ɛtutuo baa nnipa a wɔwɔ aboa no agyirahyɛdeɛ ne wɔn a wɔkotoo ne honi no so.
Na deɛ ɔtɔ so mmienu no hwiee ne kuruwa no guu po mu. Na ɛdanee sɛ owufoɔ mogya, na ɛpo no mu mmoa nyinaa wuwuiɛ.
Na deɛ ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa no hwiee ne kuruwa no guu nsubɔntene ne asutire mu, na ɛdanee mogya. Na metee sɛ nsuo so bɔfoɔ no se:
Wo a wowɔ hɔ, na wowɔ hɔ dada, na woyɛ kronkron, wotene,
ɛfiri sɛ woabu atɛn saa,
na wɔahwie ahotefoɔ ne adiyifoɔ mogya agu,
na woama wɔn mogya anom,
wɔfata saa.
Na metee sɛ ɛnne bi firi afɔrebukyia no mu a ɛse:
Aane, Awurade Nyankopɔn, adeɛ nyinaa so tumfoɔ,
w’atemmuo yɛ nokorɛ ne tenenee.
Na deɛ ɔtɔ so nnan no hwiee ne kuruwa no guu owia so. Na wɔmaa no ogya ahoɔden sɛ ɔmfa nhyehye nnipa. Na wɔde ahuhuro kɛseɛ hyehyee nnipa, na wɔkaa Onyankopɔn a ɔwɔ ɔhaw mmusuo yi so ahoɔden no din ho abususɛm, na wɔansakyera wɔn adwene anhyɛ no animuonyam.
Na deɛ ɔtɔ so nnum no hwiee ne kuruwa no guu aboa no ahennwa so. Na n’ahennie danee sum, na yea no nti wɔkekaa wɔn tɛkyerɛma, na wɔn yea ne wɔn nkudaa nti wɔkaa ɔsoro Nyankopɔn ho abususɛm, na wɔannu wɔn ho wɔ wɔn nnwuma mu.
Na deɛ ɔtɔ so nsia no hwiee ne kuruwa no guu asubɔnten kɛseɛ Eufrate mu, na emu nsuo wee, na wɔasiesie kwan ama ahemfo a wɔfiri owia apueeɛ nohoa. Na mehunuu ahonhom fi mmiɛnsa a wɔte sɛ mponkyerɛne, sɛ wɔfiri ɔtweaseɛ no anomu ne aboa no anomu ne adiyifoɔ atorofoɔ no anomu. Na wɔyɛ ahonhommɔne ahonhom a wɔyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ, na wɔfiri kɔ wiase nyinaa ahemfo nkyɛn kɔboaboa wɔn ano ma Onyankopɔn, ade nyinaa so tumfoɔ no, da kɛseɛ no mu ko no. (Hwɛ, mereba sɛ owifoɔ. Nhyira ne deɛ ɔwɛn na ɔhwɛ ne ntadeɛ soɔ, na wannante adagya mu, na wɔanhunu ne kwaterekwa.) Na ɔboaboaa wɔn ano kɔɔ baabi a wɔfrɛ hɔ Hebri kasa mu sɛ Armagedon.
Na deɛ ɔtɔ so nson no hwiee ne kuruwa no guu ahunum. Na ɛnne kɛseɛ bi firi asɔredan no mu, firi ahennwa no mu, sɛ: Wɔawie. Na anyinam ne ɛnne ne aprannaa bae, na asasewosoɔ kɛseɛ a ɛfiri berɛ a nnipa baa asase soɔ no wɔnhunuu so asasewosoɔ kɛseɛ saa pɛn baeɛ. Na kuro kɛseɛ no mu paee afaafa mmiɛnsa, na amanaman nkuro hwehwee ase, na wɔkaee Babel kɛseɛ no, Nyankopɔn anim, sɛ wɔbɛma no n’abufuo a emu yɛ den no nsa kuruwa. Na nsupɔ nyinaa dwanedwanee, na wɔanhunu mmepɔ biara bio. Na asukɔtweaa akɛseɛ a ɛte sɛ dwetikɛseboɔ firi soro guguu nnipa so, na asukɔtweaa no haw nti nnipa kaa Nyankopɔn ho abususɛm ɛfiri sɛ na ɔhaw no so kɛse.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
